notes.title: Version 1.1.1 is here with new settings
notes.content:
Based on your feedback, we've reorganized the settings screen and added a couple new settings, including:

[list]
[*]Option to switch to a more classic, 16-bit border style
[*]Option to enable/disable movement of NPCs
[*]Different orderings when items are resorted (manually or automatically)
[/list]
We've got a few more things we're looking into, but some things may take a little longer.  We hope you're enjoying Vay!

notes.title: Version 1.1 is here
notes.content:
Hey Vay fans!  We've gone through your feedback and tried to implement the most requested new features.  This weekend's update adds the following:

[list]
[*]An option to use the original 16-color battle backgrounds
[*]Filtering options now apply to sprites in battle
[*]Healing on level up can be enabled/disabled
[*]There is now an indicator as to which party members can equip items when shopping
[/list]
We have a few more things we're looking into that will take a little more time, but wanted to get these updates out to you as soon as we could.  Enjoy!

P.S.  If you had an issue with achievements, this should be resolved now but if not, please reach out to us!

notes.title: Fullscreen settings added
notes.content: Based on feedback, we've added an option in settings if you want to force fullscreen mode on or off rather than relying on platform settings.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Version 1.0.2 has been released, which fixes an item duplication bug that can occur in the Equipment Menu.

We appreciate all your feedback and are looking into a couple of your feature suggestions for upcoming updates.  Stay tuned!

notes.title: Vay is now available!
notes.content:
Vay is available today on Steam!  We hope you enjoy this new version.

We do welcome your feedback for future updates as well as other titles.  Please feel free to email us at info@somoga.com.

notes.title: Happy July 4th!
notes.content: We hope all our North American friends have enjoyed a great Canada Day and 4th of July!  But we don't want the celebrations to end just yet... which is why we're announcing that Vay will be releasing in the next several days!

notes.title: Steam Achievements are coming!
notes.content:
To answer a question we've heard from several of you recently -

Yes, we are adding achievements to the Steam version of Vay!

We hope you enjoy this new version.  The Legendary Armor returns soon!
